q: On a two-year contract, been here five years, at the Seoul office: how much time off am I building up each month, and how much can I still be holding in January?
log:
You are building up **0.88 days per month** of leave (type E2 – two-year contract, tenure T3 – five years here, site L1 – Seoul office).

The carry-over limit is **10 days**, so that's the maximum you can still be holding into January (the start of the new year) under the current rules (in force from 2026-01-01).

DONE
